changelog: Broadcast view is a tall narrow overlay showing Items, Collectables and Keys
Key and keyring nameplates carry their own key art
In portrait the key groups sit in two columns and the group bars no longer stretch across the window
Keyrings are toggles rather than consumables, so they no longer paint a redundant 1 over the art
Boss reward checks show their monster token instead of the generic flower chest
Renamed the default variant to Individual Maps, alongside the All Maps variant
Keys grouped by map and sorted alphabetically; the section hides entirely when keys are not randomized
All Maps is a pack variant rather than a tab, with pins sized to the map art
Removed the Warps grid; warps are already shown on the map and the items stay registered
See the release notes for v1.0.2
